title: Reliability-Weighted Direct Preference Optimization: Penalized Weights for Robust Preference Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) treats every reported comparison as correct, yet preference data contain   reversed, tied or otherwise noisy comparisons. RW-DPO gives each comparison an unknown reliability weight   $w_i\in[0,1]$ that enters the likelihood linearly -- DPO is $w\equiv1$, a reversed comparison $w_i=0$ -- and estimates   the weights jointly with the policy under a minimax-concave penalty on $-\log w_i$. The penalty keeps every   comparison the model agrees with at exactly $w_i=1$ and acts only on those it contradicts, through closed-form weight   updates at negligible cost over DPO. We prove that recovering all flipped comparisons from a single annotation per   comparison requires margins of order $\log n$. translated_title: 可靠性加权直接偏好优化：用于稳健偏好学习的惩罚化权重
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化将每一条报告的比较都视为正确的，然而偏好数据中却包含反转的、平局的或其他有噪声的比较。RW-DPO 为每一条比较赋予一个未知的可靠性权重 $w_i\in[0,1]$，该权重以线性方式进入似然函数——DPO 对应于 $w\equiv1$，被反转的比较对应于 $w_i=0$——并在 $-\log w_i$ 上的极小极大凹惩罚（minimax-concave penalty）下与策略联合估计这些权重。该惩罚使模型所认同的每一条比较的权重恰好保持在 $w_i=1$，只对与模型相矛盾的比较发挥作用，并通过闭式权重更新以几乎不增加 DPO 计算成本的方式实现。我们证明，在每条比较仅有一次标注的条件下，恢复所有被翻转的比较需要 $\log n$ 量级的间隔（margin）。此外，在线性指标模型中，从指向正确方向的初始拟合出发，我们的估计量能够联合且一致地恢复偏好方向与权重。
tldr: 提出RW-DPO方法，通过为每条偏好比较引入可学习的可靠性权重并结合极小极大凹惩罚，以几乎不增加DPO计算成本的方式自动识别并降权噪声比较，实现稳健的偏好学习。
en_tdlr: RW-DPO assigns learnable reliability weights to individual preference comparisons under a minimax-concave penalty, automatically identifying and down-weighting noisy comparisons at negligible cost over DPO for robust preference learning.
